purpose: A claim feed, not a status source. Records where Plasma AI's erdosproblems.ai wiki (github.com/plasma-ai/erdos) differs from this atlas, the claim pages Plasma cites, and the atlas's review of each difference. Adding an entry NEVER changes a problem's status in this atlas: status changes when upstream changes or when the atlas holds replayable evidence.

source.changes: Metadata only (standing labels, claim status, scope, dates, authors, links, bound values), re-keyed per Erdős number and annotated with the atlas's own review. No problem statements, claim descriptions or erdosproblems.com prose copied.

review_legend.source-checked: the cited source was opened and supports the stated standing; status still held per rule 1
review_legend.annotated: Plasma's label kept as unverified by atlas; atlas status kept
review_legend.not-accepted: the atlas does not accept Plasma's standing; reason in the note
review_legend.flagged: Plasma's label disagrees with ours and ours may be the one at fault; not changed here

A sharper N^(1/5+o(1)) statement circulating on Plasma's page is an unreviewed claim and is not adopted. Atlas status held: upstream (teorth/erdosproblems, Bloom) still labels this problem open, and a claim never sets a status here (CLAUDE.md rule 1).
